verdict.rationale: Temporal is a durable-execution platform, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents an official Temporal MCP server. The llms.txt index, the CLI, and the agent-SDK integrations are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
